name: TaiChi Bodywork Center

reviews.text:
2.8.26
60min $60
90min $90

Really amazing massage. I have several issues with my muscles and fascia that require a strong massage and that is exactly what this was. It was so good.

Some of the other patrons seemed to have had a more relaxing massage, so if that's what you're looking for that I'm sure that's available as well.

The facility is pretty typical for the Thai massage places I've been too: rooms with curtains for doors, walls that don't go quite to the ceiling, etc. Very clean.

Mae did a fantastic job and I will absolutely be back.
reviews.author: Anna Johnson

reviews.text:
Here’s a shorter, more concise version:

We had a great couples massage experience. The therapists were attentive, checked in about pressure and comfort, and made sure we both felt relaxed throughout the session. The atmosphere was calm and professional.

The pricing was very reasonable for the quality of service, with no hidden fees or pressure to upgrade. We left feeling relaxed and felt it was excellent value for the price. We would definitely book again.
reviews.author: Kurt Magda

reviews.text: Love the place. I've been going there for almost 20 years now. Ever since their old location down the street across from the fire station. Very professional and skilled staff. If the tech is new there might be slight language barrier so take your time and make sure you are understood. You can't beat the price. It's been $1 a minute since I started going. So don't be cheap and tip the tech well. Basically tip $10 for every 30 minutes you get.  1/2 hour-pay $30 tip $10. You get 90 minutes-pay $90 tip $30. If they find that spot that has been killing you, tip them more
reviews.author: Damon Cunningham

reviews.text: Had a 60 minute massage and it was excellent. Not familiar with this technique of massage but I really enjoyed it. I got a medium pressure massage and it was on the more intense side which I enjoyed. It's not a fancy place but for the price and technique, can't wait to go back again.
reviews.author: Laila Reilly

reviews.text:
I booked a 90 min massage online, but halfway through my therapist left for several minutes then returned to try to make me take a cell phone call with her colleague and eventually use a translator app. My massage was being cut to 60 minutes because some man arrived and complained about waiting. I was charged for a full 60 minutes in spite of the lapse and interruption.

This is my first time returning here in 6ish years after another bad experience where the front desk man started a major argument with my therapist and then tried to switch places with her doing my massage halfway. Should have learned my lesson then.

Anyway the massage is good but you will likely have to have a language barrier discussion while naked in the middle.
reviews.author: Veronica
